# krub.dev

> Personal portfolio of Kiko Rubio, a full stack developer in Murcia (Spain): one bilingual page
> with a WebGL hero, dark and light themes, built with Vue 3, Vite and TresJS.

## Pages

- [Home](https://krub.dev/): who I am, the projects, the stack and a contact form.
- [Privacy](https://krub.dev/privacy): the privacy notice for the contact form.

## About

- Full stack developer: Java with Spring Boot and Node with Express on the backend, Vue 3 on the
  frontend.
- Based in Murcia, open to remote, on-site or hybrid roles in Murcia or Barcelona.
- Contact: contact@krub.dev
